title: NYC Rabbis Meet Mamdani Over Israel Rhetoric Concerns
summary: New York City rabbis met with academic Mahmood Mamdani to express concerns that his rhetoric regarding Israel makes Jewish people feel unsafe. Following the meeting, the rabbis stated they were "hopeful" about the discussion. Mamdani was responding to complaints that had been made on social media regarding his statements.
summary_points: NYC rabbis met with academic Mahmood Mamdani.
Rabbis stated Mamdani's rhetoric on Israel makes Jews feel unsafe.
Following the meeting, rabbis expressed they were "hopeful".
Mamdani was responding to social media complaints.
The meeting was prompted by concerns raised on social media.
